Capacity Team - Capacity LLC

# Experience and Know-How, Mixed in With Lots of Moxie

We get passionate about lots of things, and right up there is our excitement about the exceptional people we get to work with every day. Ours is not traditionally a glamorous industry, but engaging with the Capacity team makes it fun, fast-paced, and intellectually challenging. While we can’t put everyone in our company up in lights, we wanted to highlight some of the great people who are Capacity.

### Jeff Kaiden

#### Chief Executive Officer

Jeff has managed Capacity since its inception in 1999, guiding innovation in fulfillment technology and customer satisfaction. He brings a combination of engineering knowledge and passionate leadership, overseeing steady growth throughout the company’s 21-year history. Jeff works closely with Operations and Engineering to craft and deploy unique technology and materials handling solutions. Prior to founding Capacity, Jeff served as Sr. Consultant at Sigman/Kaiden Consultants, working with major corporations around the U.S. to develop and implement warehouse designs and material handling solutions, including an innovative design for the launch of Fresh Direct in NY. He also worked as PM on the design, financial modeling, development and construction of private sector infrastructure projects in Southeast Asia with Hopewell Holdings Ltd. and the Keppel Group. Jeff holds a degree in Civil Engineering and Operations Research from Princeton University.

Connect with me on LinkedIn

### Thom Campbell

#### Chief Strategy Officer

Thom has worked to grow Capacity since its earliest days alongside his co-founders. He has held a number of roles, including leading client services, and currently oversees sales and marketing. Thom takes a special interest in attracting and retaining the people who make up Capacity’s extraordinarily passionate culture. Prior to Capacity, Thom was with Morgan Stanley for 7 years, managing investment banking and investor relations for institutional mutual funds. Before joining Morgan Stanley, Thom was at Bottomline Technologies, implementing electronic payment systems for major financial institutions. Prior to that he worked at the American Institute of Chemical Engineers. Thom holds a degree in English from Princeton University. 

### Jocelyn Petersen

#### Chief Financial Officer

Jocelyn joined as CFO in January 2022 and oversees all aspects of business support and insights, financial accounting and reporting, FP&A, treasury, insurance and corporate legal matters. She is focused on driving profitable growth and strategic initiatives, generating sustainable cash flow, allocating capital to maximize value creation while managing risk across the enterprise. Prior to Capacity, Jocelyn has 25+ years of experience leading teams in companies with significant operating scale and complexity to deliver strong results. Jocelyn served in variety of executive leadership roles at Campbell Soup and Ansell Limited (including GBU CFO and ELT) as well as advanced management roles in other diversified sectors. She started her journey with 5 years of public accounting experience at Coopers & Lybrand and is a CPA (inactive).

Jocelyn holds a BS in Accounting from Rutgers University. In 2022, she earned Certificate in Business Excellence (CIBE) upon completing Columbia Business School CFO program. Mostly recently, Jocelyn has been honored as a 2023 NJBIZ Best Fifty Women in Business awarded to remarkable women who have made significant impact, demonstrated exceptional leadership, resilience and innovation paving the way for future generations.

### Karim Fofana

#### Chief Operating Officer

Karim is the COO at Capacity. He has worked in operations and logistics for more than twenty years, with previous positions at Fresh Direct and Paragon Sports in New York and LBU in New Jersey. Karim has been with Capacity for 17 years. Born in Africa, the son of a diplomat, Karim was raised and educated in Europe, with most of his time spent in Paris and Germany. Karim is fluent in French, English, Spanish, German and Wolof.

### Shatabdi Sharma

#### Chief Information Officer

Shatabdi joined Capacity in 2026 as Chief Information Officer, leading the company’s U.S. and India technology teams. She shapes the tech strategy behind Capacity’s growth—building smarter integrations, stronger analytics, and systems designed to scale alongside clients.

Before Capacity, Shatabdi was Vice President of Global Application Services at PVH Corp, the global apparel company behind Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein. There, she oversaw strategy and execution for the digital infrastructure supporting one of the world’s largest apparel supply chains, with a focus on bridging complex technology stacks with real-world logistics needs. Her earlier career includes technology leadership roles at Hitachi Consulting, Canon, Wegmans, and Home Depot, with deep experience scaling ERP, WMS, OMS, integration, and eCommerce systems.

Beyond her technical work, Shatabdi is an active leader within Extraordinary Women in Tech (EWiT) and a vocal advocate for workplace courage and reverse mentorship. She has been recognized with the 2025 Top 20 Women We Admire Award and the ISG Women in Digital Silver Luminary Award.

### Darren Lavelle

#### Chief Experience Officer

Darren joined Capacity in 2017 and brought with him decades of experience leading global customer service teams in the US, Europe and India. He is known for his practical knowledge of CRM platforms, critical timelines and supply chain complexities. Before Capacity, he was VP Global Customer Service at Mimeo, leading teams in the US, UK and Germany. Prior to Mimeo, he was VP Customer Service at Pitney Bowes, a global tech firm known for its mailing and logistics equipment and services. While there he was instrumental in leading the organization’s professional services field delivery team of systems engineers. Darren has a BA in Business Administration from USC and an MBA from Eller College of Management at the University of Arizona.

### Kevin Bernick

#### VP Relationship Managment

Kevin serves as the VP of Relationship Managment for Capacity, and also operates as the head of relationship management. For his first seven years at Capacity, he served as a valued member of the sales team where his focus was on new opportunities. Kevin aims to work closely with existing clients to ensure long-term alignment, while presenting new and exciting solutions. Prior to Capacity, Kevin worked as an outside sales representative for Process Technologies, a small distributor of process equipment and industrial flooring. Kevin is an alumnus of the United States Merchant Marine Academy and holds a BS in Marine Engineering and Shipboard Management.

### Nikil Prabhakar

#### Vice President Sales

Nikil is the VP of Sales at Capacity and has been with the firm since 2009. Nikil has wide-ranging experience in the eCommerce and fulfillment space and focuses on developing customer-driven solutions for our clients. During Nikil’s tenure, Capacity has grown from servicing a handful of clients to working with hundreds of clients across multiple facilities, in New Jersey, California, Chicago and the United Kingdom. Prior to working at Capacity, Nikil worked in the financial services industry with MF Global and at the Chicago Board of Trade in the treasury futures sector. 

#### Vice President Sales

TJ was new to the fulfillment industry in 2013 but was eager to learn the business from the ground up, starting out at his Capacity career as a Client Account Manager. Now Vice President of Sales, his role encompasses identifying business opportunities, prospecting new clients, and maintaining his current client portfolio. He takes pride in building relationships from the initial point of contact throughout the client’s lifecycle at Capacity. Prior to Capacity, TJ spent more than seven years as a collegiate football coach at his alma mater Stony Brook University and at Wagner College. TJ was the Quarterback Coach and Pass Game Coordinator at Wagner College where he earned his Master’s in Business Administration. 

#### Business Development Executive

Simon is a Business Development Executive at Capacity. Having grown up around the business, he brings a lifelong understanding of fulfillment operations to every conversation, but it’s his instinct for building genuine relationships that sets him apart. Simon works primarily with emerging and influencer-backed brands, many of which are navigating 3PL partnerships for the first time. His hospitality background gives him a natural read on what these founders need: honest guidance, not a sales pitch. Simon is known for building genuine rapport quickly, meeting prospects where they are, and proactively bringing solutions to the table, whether that means guiding a first-time buyer through the basics or identifying cost-saving opportunities, such as leveraging regional carriers, before they’re even requested.

Before Capacity, Simon worked at HaSalon and for other hospitality groups, held a social media marketing internship at Stadium Goods, and interned at Overtime. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Organizational Science from The George Washington University and studied Liberal Arts and Sciences at The American University of Paris. 

### James Gibbons

#### Financial Controller

James joined Capacity LLC in March 2020 as a Finance Manager. During his five years with Capacity, he has rapidly progressed into his current position of Controller. In this role, James oversees the managerial accounting functions of the organization, including: Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Financial Planning & Analysis, and Financial Reporting.

Prior to his time with Capacity, James was an Accounting Supervisor with a national veterinary organization and an auditor with a public accounting firm where he earned his CPA licensure.

James holds a BS in Accounting and Business Management from Saint Anselm College and completed his MSA in Accounting from Southern New Hampshire University.

His ongoing mission is to provide financial insights to support the strategic initiatives of executive leadership.

Jason joined Capacity as Head of Partnerships in July with the responsibility of building out the first official Capacity partnership program. He is focused on collaborative relationships with technology providers, vendors, consultants, agencies and customers. The program will foster a culture of transparency, trust and mutual benefit, leveraging the strengths and expertise of our partners to strengthen our own offerings and supply chain solutions. Prior to joining Capacity, Jason led the partnerships team at ChannelApe, a software company he co-founded. His entrepreneurial career path also includes 20 years as a Chiropractor owning and operating multiple clinics as well as a vitamin company. Jason earned a BS degree in Biology from The Pennsylvania State University. 

### Jennifer Nunez

#### Manager of Training and Documentation

Jennifer is a dedicated professional with a passion for teaching and continuous learning. Her journey at Capacity LLC began in 2015 as an Admin for the Client Services department, quickly progressing to a Client Account Manager and later Manager of Client Services. Her versatility and adaptability led to her current role as Manager of Training & Documentation, where she combines her expertise and deep understanding of the organization to support learners across departments. Jennifer’s dedication is evident through the success of her trained team members, the creation of comprehensive documentation, and her HazMat Certification. She thrives on guiding and inspiring others to unlock their potential and achieve their goals through mentorship and support. Jennifer is a valuable asset both professionally and within her community, exemplifying Capacity’s values.

#### Manager of Client Services

Grace has over 25 years of experience leading service teams and delivering exceptional service, emphasizing strong relationship management. Before joining Capacity, Grace held several positions, including National Wholesale Manager, Sales & Service Manager, Retail Area Manager, and Assistant Buyer. She holds a B.S. in Marketing/Merchandise Management from the Fashion Institute of Technology/SUNY. Additionally, Grace is hazmat certified and is fluent in Italian.

### Rohan Bhobe

#### Vice President of Software Development

Rohan joined the Capacity team in December 2023 as Vice President of Software Development and brings nearly 2 decades of experience in leadership positions within the logistics and supply chain industry. Prior to joining Capacity, he held various leadership roles in the Supply Chain & secondary Event Ticketing industries. He graduated as Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering in 2003 from Mumbai University in India and a Master of Engineering from Fachhochschule Lausitz University of Applied Sciences in Senftenberg, Germany in Systems Engineering & Production Planning. 

#### Director of Client Services

Kanika brings over 8 years of customer experience. She joined Capacity in May 2018 as a Client Account Manager and quickly advanced to become the Director of the Client Services team, demonstrating her “can do” attitude and solution-oriented mindset. Since 2019, she has been trained and certified to handle hazardous materials safely and in compliance with regulations under DOT, IATA, and IMDG. Prior to Capacity, Kanika led the production department for a retail home textile company, embracing the belief that there is always an opportunity for personal and professional growth in every role and phase of life. 

Working at Capacity has expanded Kanika’s understanding of supply chain management, transportation, warehousing, and other key aspects of logistics. With her prior background and experiences, she brings a unique perspective to the logistics business. As a dedicated customer service professional, she is committed to ensuring a seamless and efficient logistics experience for clients. 

### Anthony Ruiz

#### Vice President Logistics

Tony has been with Capacity since 2004. He has more than 18 years of experience in distribution center management – traditional and eCommerce, retail and wholesale. Tony was formerly Director of Retail and Wholesale Operations for Kenneth Cole in New York and served as eCommerce Operations Manager for Nordstrom.com. Prior to that, Tony served as Logistics Manager for Nordstrom, in Seattle and in Memphis. He was a Hub Manager for United Parcel Service in Los Angeles, CA, and subsequently Air Zone Operations Manager there. Tony holds a degree in Business Administration, with a Music minor, from the University of Southern California.

### Lawrence Timpson

#### Vice President Operations

Lawrence (LT) joined the Capacity team in 2018 as an Operations Manager, then our Director of Operations, and Director of Fulfillment which has led him to his current position of VP of Operations. His exceptional ability to lead is clearly visible. LT has over 25 years of experience in operations and logistics, including working with DEA compliance and FDA compliance and training. Prior to his professional career, Lawrence served on active duty for six years in the United States Air Force. 

### Sunada Chakravarthy

#### Vice President of Data Science and Analytics

Sunada Chakravarthy joined Capacity as Vice President of Data Science and Analytics in 2025. Sunada leads strategic initiatives to apply AI and data-driven decision-making across warehouse operations, optimizing process flows and driving continuous improvement at both existing and greenfield sites. Before joining Capacity, Sunada spent eight years at Walmart, where he helped design and automate next-generation fulfillment centers, including the world’s largest ASRS system. Sunada also built data science and simulation capabilities that delivered significant cost savings. Earlier, Sunada contributed to R&D efforts that advanced large-scale polysilicon reactor technology, reducing solar panel costs. Sunada holds a PhD in Mechanical Engineering from Louisiana State University and a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from VTU India. His work has earned multiple patents and been featured in leading journals and international conferences. Sunada’s leadership philosophy centers on servant leadership, hiring smart, empowering others, and building future leaders.

### Casey Pipero

#### Director of Assembly

Casey joined Capacity in September of 2020, after 20 years in operations and logistics. She fills a role that was created by our longest-standing employee and has already made a significant impact on our Value Added Services and Returns efforts. Most recently, she was VP Operations at an independently owned 3PL company, which she helped build to a multi-site facility with more than 75 clients. Previously, Casey was a buyer and production planner for an international personal care company working with manufacturing facilities overseas and with the Home Shopping Network. She earned her BS from Rutgers University in Sociology and Psychology.

#### Director of Onboarding

Erin Sheeler joined Capacity in 2018 as the first relationship manager of the newly developed department. In 2022, she was promoted to Director of Onboarding and manages the onboarding of all new Capacity clients as well as the onboarding team. She specializes in partnering with clients on strategic initiatives that can mutually benefit the brand and Capacity. Prior to Capacity, Erin worked for 12+ years on Wall Street. She rose quickly to the level of Executive Director at Oppenheimer & Co, Inc. in the specialized fields of Corporate & Executive Services, as well as Private Equity. She honed her skills of leadership, relationship management, contract negotiation, and project management during her tenure. Erin earned a BS in Business Administration with a concentration in finance and a minor in Sociology from Wagner College where she attended on an academic scholarship. 

#### Director of Inventory Management

Venu Muni, the Director of Inventory Management at Capacity, brings a powerful combination of experience and expertise to enhance the accuracy of our client inventory. Since joining Capacity in 2022, Venu has utilized her nearly 20 years of success in supply chain management, inventory management, quality control, procurement, operations, and operational excellence to deliver substantial outcomes. She holds an Executive MBA from Rutgers Business School, which showcases her deep understanding of business leadership and strategy. Additionally, she possesses two Master of Science degrees. Being a Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) and a Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM). Beyond her professional accomplishments, Venu is fervent about empowering women in leadership roles. As a founding associate Board member of the Rutgers Center for Women In Business, she actively supports the advancement of women in the industry. 

#### Site Leader C2

Daina Pellicier joined Capacity in 2018 as an Operations Supervisor and was later promoted to Operations Manager in 2020. In 2021, she further advanced her career as a Site Leader, becoming the first and only female to hold this role. Prior to joining Capacity, Daina demonstrated rapid growth within the company, progressing from a floor associate to becoming the company’s lead Safety Trainer. Throughout her career, she has developed exceptional problem-solving, leadership, and relationship management skills. Daina holds a BS in Sociology and Criminal Justice, and her tenure at Capacity has also enabled her to become bilingual in Spanish.

### Kristina Crockett

#### Vice President – Finance

## If you’re a member of the media and are interested in Capacity, email marketing@capacityllc.com.

## The Capacity Story

Capacity has been a player in the third-party logistics (3PL) industry since 1999. 

- Focus on Expertise: From the start, Capacity has focused on providing expert order fulfillment services, warehousing, and value-added services like assembly.
- Technological Investment: We have consistently invested in technology to support our services. We have dozens of in-house engineers and IT specialists who support both our proprietary systems and key integrations.
- Bicoastal (and beyond) Reach: Capacity boasts a bicoastal presence with facilities in New Jersey, California, as well as our Midwest facility in Indiana. This strategic positioning allows us to offer faster shipping times and more flexible transportation solutions.
- Industry Focus: From the beginning, Capacity focused on ambitious brands. In the past decade, that has led to ongoing relationships with celebrity and influencer-backed brands, especially in the beauty space. 
- Ecommerce and B2B Focus: Capacity has always worked with ecommerce DTC brands, even before it was cool. But we also have great relationships with retailers, including a consolidator relationship with Sephora and Ulta.

## Press Assets

Capacity LLC offers a comprehensive toolkit to equip journalists and media professionals with the resources they need to tell our story. Download high-resolution logos, access press coverage, and discover our executive team.

# Capacity Announces Appointment of Kevin H. Adams as Chief Operations Officer

---

Capacity LLC | The Herald-Mail

NORTH BRUNSWICK, N.J., April 30, 2021 (SEND2PRESS NEWSWIRE) — Capacity LLC, trusted leader in modern order management and direct-to-consumer eCommerce fulfillment, is proud to announce that Kevin H. Adams will be the company’s new Chief Operations Officer.

Kevin is a proven leader with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of transforming business enterprises in diverse environments. He brings the wisdom of more than 20 years of progressive leadership to Capacity, with experience in roles ranging from manufacturing and distribution to logistics and professional services.

As a graduate of the United States Military Academy – West Point and with an MBA degree in Operations Management from Indiana Wesleyan University, Kevin’s educational background is as impressive as his professional career. Moving on from active duty, he transitioned to prominent engineering roles for both midsize and large global manufacturing firms in the aerospace, automotive and medical device sectors.

Of this key appointment, Capacity’s Chief Commercial Officer Noah Sange says: “I am thrilled to be working alongside Kevin again. He is an amazing operator, laser focused on leadership, team building, and has a strong history of successful execution against clearly defined objectives, no matter how complex the environment. We are looking forward to the immense benefit that Kevin will bring to all of our employees and clients.”

With an important addition to the executive team secured, Capacity provides a foundation for operational excellence and exceptional order fulfillment. The firm’s experienced leaders and facilities in key locations across the US, as well as strategic partner hubs serving Europe, demonstrate how Capacity is investing heavily to do even more to serve existing clients and attract new business partners.

About Capacity LLC:

Since 1999, Capacity LLC has delighted clients and their customers by delivering exceptional order experiences, via custom-engineered fulfillment solutions, value-added services, and tier-one technology. Strategic locations on each coast and Chicago reduce transit times, facilitate cost-effective shipping, and provide flexible transportation solutions. All coastal facilities are close to the major ports of Los Angeles/Long Beach and Newark/New York.

Visit https://www.capacityllc.com/ to learn more.

Capacity also has well-developed infrastructure serving the European market, with fulfillment operations in the UK near London’s Gatwick Airport, in partnership with Yusen Logistics subsidiary ILG UK. The company provides domestic and international distribution for brands with a global reach.

Capacity Announces Appointments of Josh Krueger as COO and Nick Curattalo as Head of Partnerships

# Capacity Announces Appointments of Josh Krueger as COO and Nick Curattalo as Head of Partnerships

 Capacity LLC 

Jul 16, 2019, 13:38 ET

NORTH BRUNSWICK, N.J., July 16, 2019 /PRNewswire/ -- Capacity LLC, trusted leaders in order fulfillment, eCommerce, and EDI solutions, has confirmed two key appointments for the company, with a new Chief Operating Officer, Josh Krueger, and Nick Curattalo coming on as Head of Partnerships.

With a background in retail logistics and fulfillment, Krueger is eminently qualified to take up this new role with Capacity. After starting his career at WalMart, Josh made the jump to Amazon in its early days, climbing up the managerial ranks in various roles including oversight of robot-automated facilities.

Krueger then joined the eCommerce brand Zulily as VP of Fulfillment. He coordinated a multimillion-dollar project to create a state-of-the-art fulfillment center, with a focus on automation and accelerating delivery times. Krueger moves to his new position at Capacity from the VP of Logistics role at QVC in Pennsylvania, where he moved after the acquisition of Zulily.

Nick Curattalo joins Capacity from Newgistics and Pitney Bowes, having previously spent a decade at DHL specializing on eCommerce parcel shipping solutions. His ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver compelling fulfillment and shipping strategies will serve Capacity's expanding client base with fresh ideas and creative solutions, while helping Capacity form new partnerships and explore new industry verticals. In a dynamic and complex retail landscape, Curattalo's Head of Partnerships position will play a pivotal role in keeping Capacity at the forefront of eCommerce fulfillment.

"Josh and Nick join our passionate team at a crucial juncture for Capacity," says Thom Campbell, Capacity's Chief Strategy Officer. "With our investment in the latest technology and a brand-new fulfillment center coming online in 2020, we need talent. We seek the brightest minds, broad experience, and strong leaders in operational and strategic excellence. At this point in our growth we need leaders who can continue to cultivate a strong culture of leadership at all levels. Our new Chief Operating Officer and Head of Partnerships deliver all of these qualities and much more."

These appointments, viewed alongside the company's expanded relationships with tier-one fulfillment technology partners and a state-of-the-art facility opening in 2020, show that Capacity continues to develop its ability to offer premium order fulfillment services.

About Capacity LLC:

Since 1999, Capacity LLC has offered expert order fulfillment services, warehousing, value-added services, assembly services, and technology solutions to businesses nationwide. Capacity LLC provides a bicoastal fulfillment solution, from four facilities in North Brunswick, NJ, and a fifth in City of Industry, CA. These strategic locations on both coasts allow for reduced transit times, cost-effective shipping, and more flexible transportation solutions. All five facilities are close to the major ports of Los Angeles/Long Beach and Newark/New York. The company also has well-developed infrastructure serving the European market, with fulfillment operations in Lyon, France and a facility near London's Gatwick Airport in partnership with Yusen Logistics subsidiary ILG. Information: https://www.capacityllc.com/

Contact: Gordon Platt 917-710-2747 gplatt@capacityllc.com
